prerequisites: Knowledge of terminology and fundamental principles of simulator development and control algorithm design within the range of the topics presented in the lectures.

learning_outcomes.text: The course is proposed for a small group of students in a computer laboratory, where the lecture and exercise part are mixed, i.e. each topic is followed by a computer simulation performed by students themselves.

syllabus_topics: Operator and Engineering Simulators - basic types, use
Software support for industrial process modelling - examples from power plants and engines
bibliography: Šulc, B., Vítečková, : Theory and Praxis of Control Loop Design. (In Czech). Monograph of the CTU Publishing House, Prague 2004
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
